name: Mazzranache
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Mazzranache's bite leaves Maur Raincaller feverish and near death. A generation ago, the plainstrider haunted his grandfather's tales. Now Maur suffers delirious nightmares as the venom threatens his life.

sections.title: A Legacy of the Plains
sections.body: Maur Raincaller knew Mazzranache only through his grandfather's tales. The elder tauren spoke of a savage plainstrider with glowing red eyes, razor-sharp talons, and a toxic bite unlike that of most Mulgore wildlife. Then Maur met the beast on the open grass. His grandfather's warning came true, and the bite left him badly wounded as he struggled to reach safety.

sections.title: Racing the Infection
sections.body: Mazzranache's venom brings Maur a high fever and nightmarish delirium. He needs a remedy before the infection turns fatal. Traditional tauren medicine draws on the vitality of local beasts, so Maur needs a prairie wolf heart, a flatland cougar femur, a plainstrider scale, and a swoop gizzard. Together, these parts can make a brew to halt the necrotic spread and nurse him back to health.

aliases: what kind of beast is mazzranache
faq.answer: Across Mulgore's grasslands, Mazzranache is a savage plainstrider. Its vivid plumage, demonic red eyes, fierce talons, and venomous bite have terrorized travelers for generations.
Maur Raincaller lives in Bloodhoof Village. Mazzranache ambushed him and bit his shoulder as he crossed Mulgore, leaving him bedridden with a life-threatening infection.

faq.q: Why does Maur need parts from four different beasts?
faq.answer: Tauren remedies draw on the strengths and spiritual essences of plains animals to counter potent toxins. A wolf heart, cougar femur marrow, plainstrider scale, and swoop gizzard together make an antidote strong enough to fight Mazzranache's venom.
No. Maur's grandfather fought Mazzranache years ago but could not defeat the fierce plainstrider. He survived and warned his descendants of its bright colors and vicious attacks.

faq.q: Does this quest ask me to hunt down Mazzranache itself?
faq.answer: No. Maur needs to survive the fever, so the immediate need is to gather the parts for his cure.
Bloodhoof Village lies in central Mulgore, south of Thunder Bluff and east of Stonebull Lake. Young tauren braves begin their journeys across the plains from this settlement.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see Maur's remedy follow an old practice: drawing cures from the flora and fauna of the Earth Mother.
As a hunter, you can read the plains by tracking prairie wolves, cougars, plainstriders, and swoops across Mulgore.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Bloodhoof Village against Mulgore's dangers and support peace and stability in the tauren homeland.
